page.overview:
What is Jessie's Dream?

Jessie's Dream is a song recorded by the English rock band The Beatles and featured in the 1967 television film Magical Mystery Tour. Credited to McCartney-Starkey-Harrison-Lennon, it was recorded on 12th October 1967 at De Lane Lea Studios and is an instrumental composition, unavailable on any official Beatles albums.
